candidates.review_note: Repeated digit-square map is deterministic; detect recurrence to prove non-happiness and count transitions until first reaching one.
Board zones back-to-front so cross-zone pairs add no cost. Pair weights precompute within-interval difficulty; nonnegative pair weights give Monge interval costs and divide-and-conquer partition DP.
Keep spaces within each nonempty input line, count species strings per blank-delimited dataset, sort lexicographically and round percentages to four decimals.
Enumerate each possible digit multiset once; sum digit powers and require that its decimal representation has exactly that multiset. Exclude zero.

Each selected cell starts two segments and each selected diagonal neighbour pair saves one. Double the objective to represent pair rewards as linear weights minus undirected cut costs; exact integral max-flow.
At each divisible denomination either pay its remainder or round up and receive change; memoization shares the at-most-two adjacent carry states per denomination.
Enumerate sums of at least two consecutive positive squares below b, using the sample to exclude singleton squares. Deduplicate palindromic sums before adding.
